facts.text: East Texas Baptist University offers the ETBU Promise Scholarship for Children of Texas Baptists (BGCT) Senior Pastors, which is awarded for a maximum of eight semesters or up to 120 attempted hours based on meeting scholarship criteria each semester.

sources.title: ETBU Promise Scholarship for Children of Texas Baptists (BGCT) Senior Pastors | East Texas Baptist University
sources.quote: The ETBU Promise Scholarship for Children of Texas Baptists (BGCT) Senior Pastors will be awarded for a maximum of eight (8) semesters or up to 120 attempted hours based on meeting criteria of the scholarship each semester.
